```yaml
name: Build macOS Binary

on:
  release:
    types: [published]

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: macos-14

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v3

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v4
        with:
          python-version: '3.9'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install pyinstaller

      - name: Build macOS binary
        run: |
          pyinstaller --onefile --windowed --icon=assets/icon.icns a2a_scanner.py

      - name: Archive binary
        run: tar czvf a2a-scanner-${{ github.ref_name }}.tar.gz dist/a2a_scanner

      - name: Upload binary to release
        uses: actions/upload-release-asset@v3
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        with:
          upload_url: ${{ github.event.release.upload_url }}
          asset_path: a2a-scanner-${{ github.ref_name }}.tar.gz
          asset_name: a2a-scanner-${{ github.ref_name }}.tar.gz
          asset_content_type: application/gzip

  update-homebrew:
    needs: build
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout homebrew-ai-defense repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v3
        with:
          repository: cisco-ai-defense/homebrew-ai-defense
          token: ${{ secrets.HOMEBREW_TAP_TOKEN }}

      - name: Update Homebrew formula
        run: |
          sed -i '' "s/version .*/version '${{ github.ref_name }}'/" Formula/a2a-scanner.rb
          shasum -a 256 a2a-scanner-${{ github.ref_name }}.tar.gz | awk '{print $1}' > a2a-scanner-${{ github.ref_name }}.tar.gz.sha256sum
          sed -i '' "/sha256 .*/d" Formula/a2a-scanner.rb
          echo "sha256 $(cat a2a-scanner-${{ github.ref_name }}.tar.gz.sha256sum)" >> Formula/a2a-scanner.rb

      - name: Commit and push changes
        run: |
          git config --global user.name 'GitHub Actions'
          git config --global user.email 'actions@github.com'
          git add Formula/a2a-scanner.rb
          git commit -m "Update a2a-scanner to ${github.ref_name}"
          git push origin master
```
